evals.name: signed-client-draft-send-sign
evals.prompt: 用 Python（requests，不要用契约锁官方 SDK）写一个契约锁开放平台的调用模块，AppToken/AppSecret 从环境变量读，先连测试环境。然后用它完成：给新员工张三（手机 13800000000）发一份劳动合同，合同文件是本地的“劳动合同.pdf”；我们公司“示例科技有限公司”先用印章 2490828768980361630 自动盖公章，张三后签字；最后返回张三的签署链接，链接要 3 天内有效。我们没有在云平台配置业务分类。
evals.expected_output: 一个可运行的 Python 模块：Base URL 为测试环境 openapi.qiyuesuo.cn；每个请求带四个 x-qys-open-* 头，签名为 MD5(AppToken+AppSecret+timestamp+nonce)；按 草稿(send=false) → multipart 上传文件 → 发起(带签署位置) 的顺序调用；签署位置用草稿返回的 actionId / signatoryId 绑定；发起后调公章静默签；用 pageurl 接口带 user 与 3 天有效期拿签署链接；成功判定兼容 code 与 responseCode。
expectations: The base URL is https://openapi.qiyuesuo.cn (test environment), not openapi.qiyuesuo.com or any invented host

Every request sends x-qys-open-accesstoken, x-qys-open-timestamp (milliseconds), x-qys-open-nonce (a fresh UUID per request) and x-qys-open-signature; there is no Authorization/Bearer header and no token-exchange call

x-qys-open-signature is the lowercase hex MD5 of AppToken + AppSecret + timestamp + nonce concatenated in that order; the signature does not include the URL, query string or request body, and is not an HMAC
The flow is POST /v2/contract/draft with send false, then POST /v2/document/addbyfile as multipart/form-data with contractId, title, fileSuffix pdf and the file, then POST /v2/contract/send

The company signatory has tenantType COMPANY with actions containing a COMPANY-type action, the person has tenantType PERSONAL with receiver {contact: 13800000000, contactType: MOBILE}, and ordering puts the company first (serialNo 1 / 2 with ordinal true or default)

Signing positions in /v2/contract/send bind the company position with the actionId and the personal position with the signatoryId returned by the draft call, each with the documentId from addbyfile, using relative 0-1 coordinates or a keyword rather than pixels
After sending, the company seal is applied via POST /v2/contract/companysign with the contractId and sealId 2490828768980361630
The signing link comes from POST /v2/contract/pageurl with user {contact, contactType} for Zhang San and expireTime 3 with expireTimeUnit DAYS, reading result.pageUrl
Responses are parsed as JSON and success is judged by code == 0 or responseCode == "00000000" rather than by HTTP 200 alone

evals.name: contract-callback-receiver
evals.prompt: 用 Python Flask 写契约锁的合同状态回调接口。我们创建合同草稿时把订单号作为 bizId 传了，开放平台应用的回调没有开启加密。要求：合同签署完成后，把合同 PDF 下载到 contracts/{订单号}.pdf，并把订单标记为已签约；合同被退回或撤回时把订单标记为待重发。写出回调接口和它调用契约锁接口的代码（签名请求部分可以写成 helper）。
evals.expected_output: Flask 路由从 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表单读 contractId 等字段；处理幂等（契约锁失败会重推 7 次）；快速返回，下载放后台；不臆造回调签名头，而是用签名请求回查 GET /v2/contract/detail 取状态与 bizId；已完成时用 /v2/document/download 下载 PDF（或说明 /v2/contract/download 默认是 ZIP），只下载一次；按 COMPLETE / REJECTED / RECALLED 更新订单。
expectations: The callback fields are read from the form body (request.form), not from request.get_json() or a raw JSON body
The handler is idempotent for repeated deliveries (the platform retries up to 7 times at 5m, 2h x4, 12h, 24h), for example by de-duplicating on contractId plus status
The endpoint returns quickly and the download is done asynchronously or after enqueueing

The code does not invent a signature header or HMAC check for contract callbacks; it either notes that none is documented or confirms the state by calling GET /v2/contract/detail with a properly signed request
The order number is recovered from bizId in the contract detail (or from businessData if it was set), not assumed to be in the callback
The PDF is fetched with GET /v2/document/download?documentId=... for the contract documents, or /v2/contract/download is used with the understanding that it returns a ZIP by default
Completed state is recognised as COMPLETE, and REJECTED / RECALLED map to the re-send state, using the platform's status names
Signed requests to the platform use the four x-qys-open-* headers with MD5(AppToken + AppSecret + timestamp + nonce)
The code avoids re-downloading the same document on every callback, since repeated downloads of one document can lock it for 12 hours

evals.name: recall-delete-or-invalidate
evals.prompt: 契约锁上有一份合同发错了（已知 contractId）。写一个 Python 函数：先判断它现在的状态，草稿就直接删掉，还在签署中就撤回，已经全部签完的就发起作废（作废原因“信息填写错误”，我们公司之前没有在这份合同上盖过章，作废文件用印章 2589678690921123947，要求 30 天内完成作废）。函数返回做了什么以及作废是否已经生效。
evals.expected_output: 函数先用 GET /v2/contract/detail 取 status，然后统一调用 POST /v2/contract/invalid：草稿即删除、签署中即撤回、已完成即发起作废并传 sealId、reason、expireTime（yyyy-MM-dd，30 天后）；说明作废要所有签署方签署作废文件后才变为 INVALIDED，调用返回时状态是 INVALIDING，需通过回调或详情轮询确认。
expectations: The function reads the current status with GET /v2/contract/detail before acting
All three cases use the single endpoint POST /v2/contract/invalid; the code does not invent separate endpoints such as /contract/delete, /contract/cancel, /contract/revoke or /contract/recall
For a COMPLETE contract the request includes sealId 2589678690921123947 (required because the initiator has not signed) and reason 信息填写错误
The invalidation deadline is passed as expireTime in yyyy-MM-dd format about 30 days ahead
The function reports that invalidation of a completed contract only takes effect after all signatories sign the invalidation document, so the immediate state is INVALIDING rather than INVALIDED
Statuses are compared using the platform's names DRAFT, SIGNING (and FILLING), COMPLETE, INVALIDING, INVALIDED
Requests carry the four x-qys-open-* headers with MD5(AppToken + AppSecret + timestamp + nonce) and success is judged by code == 0 or responseCode == "00000000"
